verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints that verification is built into the platform: an Issuing docs page covers forcing verification-check failures to test error handling, and cards are issued only after an account holder is created. Adyen's banking licenses suggest compliance is handled in-platform. Nothing in the pack describes how KYC or KYB actually works. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB data requirements, distinction between consumer and business verification, review/verification status states, re-verification flows, and independent corroboration.
